title: World Series Baseball
overview:
Step up to the plate with the premier video game in baseball: World Series Baseball

- Saturn technology delivers unbelievable color, 3-D graphics and ultra-smooth perspective tracking.
- Enjoy incredible detail from 5 different ballpark perspectives.
- Swing for the fences at Fenway or another one of the game's ultra realistic major league ballparks.
- Track and store all key stats for pitching and batting.
- CD-quality sound rocks with continuous play-by-play announcing, true ballpark anthems, and dynamic crowd responses.
- Choose among play modes including 162-game pennant race, All-Star and Play-Off modes as well as a power-hitter duel in "Home Run Derby."
- Play as any one of the 28 major league teams, complete with high-resolution player photos.
